audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was scored as Lillia in both layers while the packet chart and the content 'why' both say Ryze wins the level-1 poke.
audit.why: Overload (Q) is a 1000-range line on a 5s cooldown; Blooming Blows (Q) is a 450-range ring. Lillia has no way to contest level 1.
audit.corrected: Level 1 flipped to Ryze in phases[0].side and win[0], rating dropped to 4/10, and the why rewritten to the range gap.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why and phases[6].why praised Lillia's Liandry's/teamfight spike on rows whose side is Ryze.
audit.why: The page told a paying user Ryze wins those stages while the sentence underneath described Lillia dominating them.
audit.corrected: Both whys rewritten to match the side: Ryze's Tear item lands alongside Liandry's, and Archangel's plus 5s Overload resets out-statcheck the burn at 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rune Prison was described as a 'point-blank root' in three places. It is 615 range and only roots when Spell Flux (E) is already on the target; otherwise it damages and slows.
audit.why: Riot's own text: 'traps a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.' The dodge that matters is Spell Flux, not the cage.
audit.corrected: All three strings restated: dodge the 615-range Spell Flux and Rune Prison is a 9-11s slow, not a pin. Cooldown 11/10.5/10/9.5/9 given as the commit window.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown number anywhere for the punishable spell.
audit.why: Rune Prison at 9-11s is the only long cooldown in Ryze's kit — Overload is 5s and Spell Flux is 2.5-3.5s, so 'wait for his cooldowns' is meaningless except for W.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to dosFull[2].d and report[5].t.

edits.before: Q's outer ring on his last-hits plus the passive speed means he literally cannot touch you at level 1.
edits.after: Overload is a 1000-range line against your 450 ring — he chips you for free, so last-hit and concede level 1.

edits.before: Liandry's spike — Dream Dust plus the burn melts juggernauts and tanks alike while you jog circles around them.
edits.after: Liandry's burn is real, but his Tear item lands too — spikes cancel, and one Spell Flux into Rune Prison still ends you.

edits.before: You're a teamfight nightmare now: sleep two, kite the rest, and let the burn do the bookkeeping.
edits.after: Archangel's and his 5s Overload resets out-statcheck your burn — sleep from fog, then leave; never duel him.

edits.before: Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Rune Prison is 615 range and only roots after Spell Flux (E) sticks — dodge the E and the cage is just a slow.

edits.before: Ryze spends Rune Prison (Root) early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Rune Prison is 9-11s. Once he burns it, you have a whole window to walk in and ring him.

edits.before: Track Ryze’s Rune Prison (Root): Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Rune Prison: 615 range, and it only roots if Spell Flux (E) already hit you — dodge the E and the cage is a slow, not a pin.

edits.before: Ryze out-ranges your short hops at level 1, so don't try to trade your single Blooming Blows into his Q poke — just last-hit at Q sweetspot range and concede the opening. The key is his root chain: Overload (Q) into Rune Prison (W) or the Q-E-Q combo will pin you, and a pinned Lillia is a dead Lillia since you have no defensive button. By levels 2-3 you start layering the E Swirlseed slow with Q and the Dream Dust burn begins ticking — use the E slow to keep distance, not to engage.
edits.after: Ryze out-ranges your short hops at level 1, so don't try to trade your single Blooming Blows into his 1000-range Q poke — last-hit at Q sweetspot range and concede the opening. The key is the order: Rune Prison (W) only roots if Spell Flux (E) already hit you, so dodge the 615-range E and the cage is a 9-11s slow instead of a pin — and a pinned Lillia is a dead Lillia. By levels 2-3 you layer the E Swirlseed slow with Q and the Dream Dust burn starts ticking — use the E slow to keep distance, not to engage.

notes: Level-1 row was flipped as a matched full+content pair. Rune Prison's root condition (requires Spell Flux) was the decisive interaction the page never stated. Realm Warp (180/160/140s) is a 3000-range group teleport, not a duel tool — left unmentioned per the relevance rule since it does not change lane play.
